options.name: Religious census on active and passive electoral rights.
options.desc: Only adult citizens who are part of the Graic Church are allowed to vote and hold government positions.

options.name: Religious census on passive electoral rights.
options.desc: Every adult citizen has a voting right regardless of their religion, however there exists a religious census regarding government position candidates.

options.name: Secular elections
options.desc: All adult citizens can elect and be elected to the government regardless of their religion.
